subject: Literature
title: Twelfth Night and Gender Play
description: One-minute skill: Twelfth Night and Gender Play.

hook.text: A woman disguises herself as a man, and everyone falls in love with the wrong person in a cascade of confusion.

buildup.text: Viola becomes Cesario, and both Duke Orsino and Lady Olivia are drawn to her without knowing her true identity.

discovery.text: On Shakespeare's stage, a boy played Viola playing Cesario, creating dizzying layers of gender performance.

twist.text: Modern queer scholars see the play as Shakespeare's most radical exploration of fluid gender and desire.

climax.text: Twelfth Night suggests that identity is always a performance and love does not follow neat categories.

punchline.text: Four hundred years ago, Shakespeare queered the stage.

quiz.question: Why is Twelfth Night significant for gender studies?
options: A boy played a woman disguised as a man, creating layers of gender performance
It is Shakespeare's only play with a female lead
